name: Craftsmen's Terrace
summary: Craftsmen's Terrace gathers Darnassus's trades along the city's northern edge. Its workshops, trainers, inn, and Argent Dawn embassy draw artisans and visitors alike.

sections.title: The Artisan Heart of Darnassus
sections.body: Woodworkers, leathercrafters, alchemists, and other artisans work along the northern edge of Darnassus. Their shops bring together many of the trades that keep the city running, using night elven methods for practical crafts. You can also find an inn, a guild master, and guild petition vendors here. Bridges lead west to the Cenarion Enclave and south to the Warrior's Terrace.

sections.title: Outside Ties and Forgotten Lore
sections.body: The Argent Dawn keeps an embassy in the Craftsmen's Terrace, coordinating with northern allies against the Scourge. The district's workshops also hold scattered scholarly volumes. Among them are histories of the War of the Ancients, chronicles of the Second War, and treatises on the Old Gods.

faq.q: What services are found in the Craftsmen's Terrace?
faq.answer: The Craftsmen's Terrace has trade profession trainers, craft supply merchants, an inn, and guild registry services. Travelers come here to learn or practice practical skills in Darnassus.

faq.q: Why is the Argent Dawn present in the Craftsmen's Terrace?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn keeps an embassy in the Craftsmen's Terrace to liaise with the night elves and recruit aid against the Scourge. It connects the Alliance forces in the west with the war-torn lands of Lordaeron.

faq.q: How do you reach the Craftsmen's Terrace?
aliases: how to get to craftsmen terrace
faq.answer: The Craftsmen's Terrace occupies Darnassus's northern section. Bridges lead north from the Warrior's Terrace and east from the Cenarion Enclave.

faq.q: What notable books can be found around the workshops?
faq.answer: Scholarly volumes in the workshops include histories of the War of the Ancients, accounts of the aftermath of the Second War, and a study of the Old Gods in the Argent Dawn's quarters.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, you can see the terrace's self-reliance on Teldrassil, where ancient craftsmanship meets the daily needs of the new capital.
As an Alliance visitor, you find trade supplies, guild services, and lodging in one of Darnassus's most welcoming quarters, alongside foreign representatives.
